summary: Elk (Mastodon web client) adds read-only Mastodon Collections support: a Collections tab on profiles, a signed-in-only /collections page (my collections / collections I'm in), a page per collection, a Collections nav item (sidebar + optional bottom-nav button), and notification cards for 'added you to a collection' / 'updated a collection'. Bumps masto to ^7.12.0.

statements.text: ⚠ Anyone can open the @[account] collections page without logging in.
statements.why: True, but not a problem: it is a read-only profile tab showing public Mastodon data, exactly like the existing posts/media/followers tabs in @[account]/index/ which also have no auth middleware.

statements.text: The @[account] collections page is new. It only shows information. /[[server]]/@[account]/collections
The collections page is new. It only shows information. /[[server]]/collections
statements.why: collections.vue is a layout wrapper for the collections pages.

statements.text: Each collection page is new. It only shows information. /[[server]]/collections/[id]
statements.why: Shows name, owner, description, tag and member accounts (follow buttons use existing behaviour).

statements.text: The collections page is new. It only shows information. /[[server]]/collections (listed a second time)
statements.why: Duplicate entry for the same address; it is actually collections/index.vue, which requires sign-in (middleware: 'auth') and shows 'My collections' / 'In collections' tabs - the card never says so.

statements.text: The agent added wording in the app (locales/en.json): "Created by", "No accounts in this collection yet.", ...
The agent also changed NavBottom.vue, NavSide.vue, NotificationCard.vue and SettingsBottomNav.vue, in ways plain can't describe yet.
statements.why: True; these add the Collections nav item/bottom-nav option and collection notification cards.

statements.text: 1. Test anything that uses masto: it was upgraded from ^7.10.0 to ^7.12.0.
statements.why: masto is the core Mastodon API client; lockfile moves 7.10.0 -> 7.12.0.

misses.what: Bug on the signed-in /collections page: the 'No collections' message uses v-else on the not-supported check (collections/index.vue), so it shows under the list even when the user has collections.
New Collections item in the sidebar (and an optional bottom-nav button), plus new notification cards when someone adds you to or updates a collection.
